title: Research: certify the current idle-star physical counterexample
body:
## Summary

```diff
- PR3184: orthonormal idle axes + preserved combined multiset
+ exact physical stream check: its first committed star changes the operator
```

Adds one isolated counterexample package for PR3184 at `ffab383a5f78eb1a4ad4c7c7259a4f32b86f9481`, bound to PR3148's actual T740 allocation. At cover identity and Fourier character 16, input Y0 leaks `-1-i` to output Y1. A short interval proof also permits arbitrary diagonal hosted-helper phases, and supplies the required equation `E_receiver M = M E_donor`.

Gareth Davidson/PR1387 already identified the physical-stream obstruction on PR1094. This contribution adds the exact current-candidate binding, all actual helper occurrences, and a standalone regression. It credits Rohan Arun/PR3184, Jeremy Diviney/PR3148, Gonzalo-Mier/PR1252, Guéorgui Maissouradze/PR1276, Jeremy Kothe/PR1324 and the retained rank-seven/E8 lineage. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- **Before:** both literal moves pass the declared commuting, orthonormality, rank-cap and combined-axis conditions.
  **After:** exact Gaussian-integer replay rejects equality in three physical matrix entries; baseline is `i I_8` at the witness character.
- Independently reconstructs and authenticates all 2,717,280 fill rows and follows all 30 hosted occurrences affecting the witness. Baseline passes 147 specified modes.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, nineteen behavioral groups, optimized Python 3.13 read-only Git-free export, two internal reviews, Ruff, warning-as-error compilation and all 25 committed package/input byte checks pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-idle-star-stream-obstruction
```

Exact proof, source pins, matrices, execution limits and open next questions are in the package. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19000570).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds a research package and opt-in replay only. The counterexample assumes the candidate's unchanged completed local invocation contract. Native internals, the full supplier/outer release, all-size, precision/tape, recovery and analytic obligations were not replayed. No frozen inputs or shared scientific records change.
